violated_contract: Work the alerting plane does on behalf of a notification must not depend on the same Grafana instance staying responsive. Alert screenshots render a dashboard panel by calling back into that Grafana; when its dashboards are slow the renders time out while holding its HTTP handlers, alert evaluation fails, and the external health check flaps.
canonical_prevention: Keep unified-alerting screenshots disabled in every environment and carry dashboard/panel links in the notification template instead; a contract test pins capture=false in the checked-in values.
